extension.summary: No scrolling. No deciding. Just watching.
extension.description: Tired of scrolling through your library wondering what to watch? EasyTV handles it. It tracks your shows and always knows your next episode. When you're ready for something new, it'll suggest a show you haven't started. Throw in some movies if you want. Just sit down, press play, and enjoy. Built for Kodi 21+.
extension.news: v1.6.2 (2026-08-10) - Dialogs no longer appear as a white box with unreadable text on skins such as Arctic Fuse 3 - Movies in "TV and movies" random playlists are now mixed through the playlist instead of added at the end - A 5% movie chance now puts the movie anywhere in the list, not always on the last item - The number of movies in a playlist is unchanged, only where they appear
